key_catalyst: Memory/storage chip rout: Micron -8%, SK Hynix -9%, SanDisk -8%, Western Digital -9% on supercycle durability doubts
reasoning: The memory/storage chip rout (Micron -8%, SK Hynix -9%, WDC -9%) is a novel sector-specific catalyst not seen in recent history, and the 'sell the news' reaction to TSMC's blowout earnings—despite soft PPI reinforcing disinflation—signals fragile market sentiment that echoes the risk-off pattern on 7/13 when semis plus Iran escalation drove a -1.90% session. The first supertanker attack since the blockade was reimposed marks a fresh geopolitical escalation that, combined with rising yields overriding supportive inflation data, creates compounding headwinds that Apple's +4% alone may not offset given its single-name concentration versus broad-based semiconductor weakness across multiple QQQ components.
